[size=3]This mod contains two versions: [color=#ff0000][b]AT[/b][/color] and [color=#ff0000][b]CP[/b][/color], and you can download either one or both according to your needs.
But [b][color=#ff0000]there are some differences[/color][/b] [color=#ff0000][b]between the two versions[/b][/color], you can compare the instructions in the header image of this web page.

The main differences are:
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Because of the limitation of CP, the items included will be less than AT mode[/size]
[*][size=3]Chest and stone chest in AT version can not be recolored, but you can do that via CP version[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][color=#93c47d][b]All items' retexture in CP version can be adjusted or turned off[/b][/color]. You can directly modify the config file in this mod's folder, but it is more recommended to download the “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]” mod to make changes.[/size]


本mod包含了AT和CP两个版本，大家可以根据需要下载其中一个或者两个都下载。
但是[color=#ff0000][b]两个版本的物件存在一定差异[/b][/color]，大家可以仔细对照一下网页头部图片中的说明。

[b][u]主要的差别：[/u][/b]
1. 因为CP模式本身的限制，包含的物件会比AT模式少一些
2. AT模式中的箱子不支持自定义颜色，但是CP模式可以

[color=#93c47d][b]CP模式中的所有物品都可以通过修改参数调整样式或者关闭样式[/b][/color]，可以直接修改mod里的config文件，但是更推荐大家下载“[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]通用参数配置[/url]”这个mod进行修改

[font=Verdana][size=4][b][u]AT version[/u][/b][/size][/font]
1. Download the two preposed mods: SMAPI and the Alternative Textures     
    确保已下载了前置mod SMAPI 和 Alternative Textures

2. Download this mod, unzip it and put it into Stardew Valley's mod foler   
    下载本mod，解压后放入星露谷的mod文件夹内

3. Run the game and  go to Robin's shop to purchase the Paint Bucket Tool   
    进入游戏后，在罗宾的商店购买油漆桶工具

4. Use the Paint Bucket Tool to change craftables' look   
    通过油漆桶修改家具外观

5. For a quick search for this mod's items, just input the keyword “nano” in the Tool's interface.
    可以修改外观界面输入“nano”关键词快速查找本mod的物件


[font=Verdana][size=4][b][u]CP version
[/u][/b][/size][/font]1. Download the two preposed mods: SMAPI and Content Patcher   
    确保已下载了前置mod SMAPI 和 Content Patcher   

2. Download this mod, unzip it and put it into Stardew Valley's mod foler   
    下载本mod，解压后放入星露谷的mod文件夹内
